title: Adumbrate
summary: ADUM'BRATE, verb transitive [Latin adumbro, to shade, from umbra, a shade.] To give a faint shadow, or slight likeness; to exhibit a faint resemblance, like a shadow.

inlines.v: ADUM'BRATE, verb transitive [Latin adumbro, to shade, from umbra, a shade.] To give a faint shadow, or slight likeness; to exhibit a faint resemblance, like a shadow.
